coverage.evidence: The browser source page is served anonymously at /overlay (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/OverlayHostController.cs:36-50), and the link is built as {base}/overlay?widgetId={id}&token={token} (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Widgets/WidgetService.cs:1785-1786). The built-in sizes are FullCanvas 1920x1080, SoundOnly 1x1 with audio on, and FullCanvasWithSound, all with shutdown off (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Widgets/FirstPartyWidgetCatalogue.cs:94-107). Setup lines come only from the catalog entry, so a custom overlay has none (WidgetService.cs:1933). The dialog labels and values (Width and height, full screen, it draws nothing, Tick it, Leave it off, Leave it off, or the overlay misses events while hidden, Copy address, Copied) are in dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/i18n/en.json:86-118, and COPIED_MS is 2000 (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/components/ObsSetupAction.vue:36). The Overlays in OBS, Required overlays, Browser sources and OBS control labels are in dashboard/src/views/dashboard/obs/i18n/en.json:29,40,47,79. The OBS control row uses a 1x1 preset with both boxes off, needs obs:config:write, and is the last row (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/obs/components/RequiredOverlaysPanel.vue:50-58,71-73,126-145).

The four placeholder messages the page quotes are at OverlayHostController.cs:57-103. A deleted widget's token no longer resolves (WidgetService.cs:1806-1812), so its link gives the token-not-valid message. Only enabled, successfully built widgets are served (WidgetService.cs:1361-1371,1393-1398). The ticket exchange refuses a stale token (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/OverlayTicketController.cs:56-75). The bot refreshes a stranded source only while the OBS connection is on and, in bridge mode, a bridge page is open (dashboard/src/composables/useObsRepairsWidgets.ts:33-41; server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Obs/Recovery/ObsBrowserSourceRecoveryService.cs:22-28,93-102). Health shows A browser source is open or Nothing attached, red unless the bot repairs (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/overlays/components/OverlayDetail.vue:184-210). The Test results Sent to this overlay and Sent, but no browser source has it open are at OverlayDetail.vue:218-228 and overlays/i18n/en.json:163-169.

The Loaded in OBS badge and the Connect or Configure button both come from isAttached (ObsSetupAction.vue:154,164), which reads the live hub presence (WidgetService.cs:1932, _presence.IsWidgetAttached). The page's warning that this badge does not prove viewers see or hear the result matches the card. The attached note Events reach your stream is at overlays/i18n/en.json:157-158.

The link's origin is OverlayBaseUrl when the operator set it, otherwise the public origin of the dashboard request (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/WidgetsController.cs:60-104), and it is applied to the list and required responses (WidgetsController.cs:124-130,165). The address is copied only through a copy action and never printed (ObsSetupAction.vue:127-135; OverlayDetail.vue:97-102,312-320; a grep of dashboard .vue files finds no rendered overlayUrl). The setup values come from the dialog facts (ObsSetupAction.vue:90-125).

reader_answers.evidence: The tab, panels, Connect and Configure, Copy address and Loaded in OBS all exist as described (obs/i18n/en.json:29,40,79; ObsSetupAction.vue:154,164,190; overlays/i18n/en.json:87-92,117).

The origin rule is at WidgetsController.cs:98-104, the token as the only credential at OverlayHostController.cs:37 and OverlayTicketController.cs:29-34, and the obs:config:write gate on the OBS control row at RequiredOverlaysPanel.vue:58,71-73,141 with the label at obs/i18n/en.json:49.

Loaded in OBS and Configure come from isAttached (ObsSetupAction.vue:154,164). The Health line is at OverlayDetail.vue:196-209 and the Test result at OverlayDetail.vue:225-227. The OBS control connection is separate (RequiredOverlaysPanel.vue:47-55).

Connect and Configure open the same dialog (ObsSetupAction.vue:148-156), so the answer works even when a stale source makes the row read Connect. The size defaults and shutdown off are at FirstPartyWidgetCatalogue.cs:94-107. The bot refreshes the source itself while it controls OBS (useObsRepairsWidgets.ts:33-41; ObsBrowserSourceRecoveryService.cs:22-28).
